head: WORKTREE
summary: Counters changeset with backfill, BalanceRepository over JdbcClient, counters unmapped in AccountEntity, fixture and invariant test all present and proven by ITs. Only minor doc and test-hygiene points remain.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: 0003-add-account-posting-counters.yaml adds columns, named CHECKs and backfill; AccountCountersBackfillIT#backfillSetsEachAccountsCountersToTheSumsOfItsPostings; BalancePersistenceAdapterIT#countersCannotBeNegative. Applied changesets untouched.
signedNetOf removed from PostingRepository; BalanceRepository + BalancePersistenceAdapter; GetAccountBalanceService contract unchanged; AccountBalanceIT AC1.2/AC1.4 unchanged.
LedgerFixture.transfer updates both counters alongside the postings (LedgerFixture.java:42-43).
Counters not mapped in AccountEntity; BalancePersistenceAdapterIT#savingAnAccountEntityLeavesItsCountersUntouched forces a JPA UPDATE.

findings.description: 'Money in SQL' still prescribes sum(bigint) read as BigDecimal with longValueExact and coalesce(sum()), but no main code applies it any more (PostingPersistenceAdapter and BalancePersistenceAdapter dropped it); the rule is now unbacked.
findings.suggestion: Reword to the counter approach (bigint read as long, subtractExact, overflow raised by PostgreSQL) or mark the sum pattern as applying only to ad-hoc aggregates.

findings.description: The isolated schema is dropped only on success; if an assertion or Liquibase step fails the schema is left behind in the shared container. The Statements are also not closed.
findings.suggestion: Drop the schema in a finally block.

findings.description: Balance description has an overlong line after the edit (formatting); wording edits outside brief scope are justified by ADR 0009 but docs/adr/0004-persistence-and-money.md:58 still says 'derived' (covered by its superseded note).
